objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a 40-year-old woman who has presented with weakness and weight loss, and interpret her laboratory findings to make a diagnosis.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Over the last few months I’ve been feeling weaker than usual and I’ve unintentionally lost weight even though my diet and activity haven’t changed. I don’t have any urinary pain or increased frequency, but I’m worried about my kidney function because kidney disease runs in my family.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “Not really—I haven’t noticed any swelling in my joints. I’ve mainly just felt weaker and lost weight without changing my diet or activity.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on your scalp?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any bumps, sores, or unusual spots on my scalp. It’s been mainly generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss over the past few months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a feeling of itchiness anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any itching or a persistent itchiness anywhere on my body. It’s mainly just the generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble raising your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “Not really—I've been able to raise my arms above my head without much trouble, and I haven’t noticed any specific weakness in my shoulders.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any loss of vision or changes in my sight, and there’s been no pain with my eyes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s felt extremely hot—like a temperature above 104 °F (40 °C) that’s made you feel dizzy or very uncomfortable?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had a fever like that, and I haven’t felt dizzy or extremely uncomfortable from a very high temperature. It’s mainly been ongoing generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Not particularly—nothing out of the ordinary or majorly stressful has happened, and I haven’t felt overwhelmed. It’s mainly just the ongoing weakness and unintentional weight loss that’s been worrying me, especially with my family history of kidney problems.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any burning or discomfort when I urinate. It hasn’t been any urinary symptoms at all—just the ongoing weakness and unintentional weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been having chills. It’s mainly been the generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss over the last few months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breasts that feel fixed or don’t move?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or fixed masses in my breasts. I haven’t had any breast changes that felt different from normal.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you feeling any pain or discomfort in the side area of your abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any pain or discomfort on the side of my abdomen between my ribs and hips. It’s been pretty much just the generalized weakness and unintentional weight loss, and I haven’t noticed any new localized pain.”
